research_notes: The future compact backlog should prioritize work that advances analysis even when the probe passes, so stress testing produces reusable knowledge rather than disposable load.

This makes longer probes productive research turns in their own right.
The current run has followed that principle with methodological and policy synthesis.
The target close should still stop the sample once the class is demonstrated.
